anomalies.description: Significant water pooling visible on the ground surface near the pipe manifold base. The dark, wet appearance with reflective sheen on the asphalt/gravel surface is more pronounced than in reference images, showing standing water accumulation around the concrete pad area.

Extended wet staining/water trail visible on the ground surface extending from the equipment base toward the lower left of the image, showing moisture accumulation pattern not present in reference images.

Dark wet patches visible on brick/block surface behind the pipes showing accelerated moisture saturation compared to reference images, with uniform dark coloration indicating persistent water contact.
